scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage SetBasePTSourceTest#testCDAsetPT. 1 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[cda-not-applied-off-battlefield]: Rootless Yew's library search (ChangeType$ Creature.powerGE6,...) offers no candidate for Enigma Drake (*/4, CDA power = 6 instants/sorceries in graveyard): only 'Yes - shuffle' is asked, while a printed 6/4 Craw Wurm IS offered (probe). The search filter reads printed P/T for library cards; the derived-PT bridge (engine/rules/layers_derived.go:104 FilterDerivedPT) is only bound for Count$Valid folds. CR 604.3. Secondary translation issue: addTarget for the search maps to kind 'target' (lab/cmd/xmageport/translate.go:711) but gorge poses the pick as a 'choose' decision, so even a found card would be fallback-declined.
